claims.claim_text: A contemporary newspaper and an official OSS regimental document confirm the indexed Marcel J Clemente as a commissioned U.S. Army officer serving with OSS in Italy.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: An OSS headquarters list names Captain Marcel J. Clemente, while a May 1945 newspaper reports his promotion to major and service with OSS in Italy.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The rare exact full name, explicit OSS service in Italy and contemporaneous Captain-to-Major chronology establish the identity despite the blank rank in the index.
claims.temporal_assessment: The newspaper dates Army entry to June 1943 and overseas service to November 1943; the official list is dated 24 May 1945.
claims.match_notes: The official document includes a full officer number that is excluded from the database bundle and public site. The indexed blank rank is preserved rather than overwritten.

claims.claim_text: Before entering the Army in June 1943, Marcel J Clemente was employed by an unnamed guarantee and trust company in New York.
claims.evidence_excerpt: Formerly employed by a guarantee and trust company in New York, the army officer entered the service in June, 1943
claims.evidence_paraphrase: A contemporary promotion article explicitly sequences Clemente's employment at an unnamed New York guarantee and trust company before his June 1943 Army entry.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The same article gives the rare exact full name and explicit OSS service in Italy; an official OSS document independently confirms Captain Marcel J. Clemente.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded as the last stated civilian employment before Army service; it is not treated as immediate pre-OSS because Army service intervened.
claims.match_notes: The source does not identify the company's legal name or Clemente's role. Neither is guessed, and the unnamed employer remains a literal source description.
